commands.description: Command prefixes such as "swift test" or "make docs". The longest match wins, project rules before global ones.

scripts.description: package.json script names run through npm, pnpm, yarn, or bun.

concurrency.description: Max jobs per class at once.

reserve.description: Memory to keep free for everything else. Default 2GB.

pauseBelow.description: Pause the newest agent job when free memory drops below this percent.

resumeAbove.description: Resume paused jobs once free memory is back above this percent.

killFloor.description: Floor under the runaway ceiling, as a percent of RAM. Nothing below it is ever a runaway.

shims.description: Extra tools to gate, or built-in ones to drop. Run `turnstile shims` after changing.

agentEnv.description: Extra environment variables that mark a shell as an agent's.

size.description: A size such as "512MB", "4GB", or "1.5 GB", or a number of megabytes.

rule.description: A class, "pass" to never gate, or an object with a class and a memory estimate.

inject.description: Add parallelism and heap limits to commands. Anything you pass yourself wins.

jobs.description: Parallelism to inject. Default: halved under 25% free memory, quartered under 15%.

nodeHeap.description: Node's --max-old-space-size. Default: capped at 2 GB under 15% free memory.

maxMemory.description: Hard ceiling; a job tree above it is killed.

killMultiplier.description: Treat a job as a runaway past this multiple of its high-water peak (never below killFloor). A runaway is only paused, and killed only if memory stays critical; maxMemory is the hard limit.

pause.description: Allow this project's agent jobs to be paused under memory pressure.
